research_question: Does a multimodal detector's uncertainty remain trustworthy as sensor quality progressively degrades, or does prediction quality deteriorate faster than confidence reflects?

clean_split.note: Validation is a temporally held-out segment from the same recording, not an independent sequence-level test set.

real_fog.note: fog_6_0 is strictly held out from training, checkpoint selection, architecture selection, and threshold tuning.

model.architecture: Three-branch BEV detector with ResNet-18/FPN-style feature extraction, fixed-slot feature concatenation, fusion neck, and CenterNet-style detection head.

branches.camera: LiDAR-assisted camera BEV generated by projecting RGB features/colors using LiDAR-derived geometry

model.important_note: The camera branch is not a pure monocular camera detector.

training.note: All controlled degradations and external evaluations use the same frozen corrected checkpoint.

evaluation.macro_metrics: Precision, recall and F1 averaged only across classes with ground-truth instances.
evaluation.calibration_definition: Calibration is evaluated over emitted detections. Confidence is the maximum predicted class probability; an event is correct when class matches and IoU >= 0.5 with an unmatched ground-truth object.
evaluation.false_negative_note: False negatives are not directly included in the calibration event set; mAP and recall complement calibration metrics.
evaluation.zero_prediction_note: Calibration metrics are undefined when no detections are emitted and are reported as N/A in paper-ready tables.

conditions.C2: Raw LiDAR degradation; degraded LiDAR geometry also propagates into the LiDAR-assisted camera-BEV projection
conditions.C2a: LiDAR-BEV feature-branch ablation only; not full physical LiDAR removal
conditions.C4: Matched camera + LiDAR synthetic degradation with radar clean

stochastic_protocol.note: Stochastic controlled degradations use one fixed reproducible realization; results are not presented as multi-seed statistical estimates.

claim_boundaries: Synthetic C4 degradation is a controlled stress test, not a validated physical reproduction of real fog.
C3 radar corruption is controlled sensor stress, not atmospheric fog attenuation.
Branch-only results are inference-time ablations of the frozen multimodal checkpoint, not separately trained unimodal architectures.
Do not infer intrinsic sensor superiority from branch ablations.
Real fog is an external domain-shift evaluation and differs in scene and class distribution from city_3_0.
Common-class Car+Van mAP is used when directly comparing clean/C4 with real fog.
Detection and calibration metrics must be interpreted jointly.
